summaryJa: 任務報告（INHERENT RESOLVE、発信: 12 SOS）によれば、機体（表記赤字: (b)(1)1.4a）は200823ZにOJMSをSLR経由で離陸。1102Zに最初のオンステーション（37S FV 85）でFMV/SIGINT収集を実施し、当該地点で3機のADMと1台のMOTOを確認、NSTRを観測した。1230Zの別オンステーション（37S FU 36）では車両1台を観測し、1230–1313Zは“eyes free”状態、1313–1410ZにかけてADM搭載MOTOに対する3回のストップフォローを実施。1559ZにFMVカメラ映像上で原因不明の光／グレア（UAP）を観測（FMVフィード上をフラッシュ）、観測後の挙動に変化はなく評価は良性。0124Zに基地へ帰還、0447Zに着陸。ミッション合計20時間24分、FMV合計14時間22分、SIGINT合計13時間02分、FMVタスキング3回、SIGINTタスキング3回。天候は快晴、搭載機器にTGTポッドAN/DAS-4およびSANTA FE等記載あり。
summaryEn: According to the MISREP (Operation INHERENT RESOLVE, originator: 12 SOS), the aircraft (redacted as (b)(1)1.4a) departed OJMS via SLR at 200823Z. It arrived on-station at 1102Z (37S FV 85) and conducted FMV/SIGINT collection, observing 3 ADMs and one moto near the SP with no significant activity (NSTR). At 1230Z (37S FU 36) it observed one vehicle; 1230–1313Z was eyes free pending SI, and 1313–1410Z conducted three stop-follow actions on an ADM-mounted moto. At 1559Z the crew observed an unidentified aerial phenomenon (UAP) described as a light/glare flashing across the FMV camera feed; there was no change after observer actions and the UAP was assessed as benign. The aircraft returned to base at 0124Z and landed at 0447Z. Total mission time 20:24, FMV 14:22, SIGINT 13:02; 3 FMV and 3 SIGINT taskings. Weather: clear. Sensors noted include AN/DAS-4 and SANTA FE.
